fields.description: Save magic header; full 8-byte field reads 'F_P_ACE\0' (Fire Pro Wrestling ACE). First 4 bytes match magic_signatures.
fields.evidence: Raw bytes at save offset 0x0 in samples/baseline.sav: 46 5F 50 5F 41 43 45 00. Flash sector I/O rooted at FUN_080466e8 / FUN_080467a8 / FUN_08046890 (0x0E000000 range); load path FUN_08038148.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Slot 0 status flag: 0x80 = active/default wrestler (YAMATO). Observed values across the 200-slot table: 0x80 default, 0x81 edited CAW, 0x00 empty, 0x03 special/boss.
fields.evidence: FUN_080377b8 copies one flag byte per slot (save stride 0x48, ROM struct stride 0x1f0, 200 iterations) into the RAM save buffer; slot 0 flag lands at save offset 0xa56c = 0x80 in baseline.sav. Flag-reader loop FUN_080378a4 iterates the same 200 slots.
fields.name: wrestler_00_status

fields.description: Slot 0 family/last ring name, NUL-padded ('YAMATO'). First of the three name blobs copied per slot (0x12 bytes).
fields.evidence: FUN_080377b8 second-loop 0x12-byte copy lands at slot_base+1; slot 0 gives save range 0xa56d..0xa57e, ASCII 'YAMATO' in baseline.sav.
fields.name: wrestler_00_last_name

fields.description: Slot 0 given/first name, NUL-padded ('FIGHTER'). Second name blob per slot (0x14 bytes).
fields.evidence: FUN_080377b8 second-loop 0x14-byte copy lands at slot_base+0x13; slot 0 gives save range 0xa57f..0xa592, ASCII 'FIGHTER' in baseline.sav.
fields.name: wrestler_00_first_name

fields.description: Slot 0 nickname/title, NUL-padded ('The Dragon'). Third name blob per slot (0x1e bytes).
fields.evidence: FUN_080377b8 second-loop 0x1e-byte copy lands at slot_base+0x27; slot 0 gives save range 0xa593..0xa5b0, ASCII 'The Dragon' in baseline.sav.
fields.name: wrestler_00_nickname

fields.description: Slot 1 status flag: 0x80 = active/default wrestler (KEISUKE). Confirms the 0x48 stride (slot 1 base = 0xa56c + 0x48).
fields.evidence: FUN_080377b8 slot loop steps save offset by 0x48; slot 1 flag at save offset 0xa5b4 = 0x80 in baseline.sav.
fields.name: wrestler_01_status

fields.evidence: FUN_080377b8 0x12-byte copy at slot_base+1; slot 1 gives save range 0xa5b5..0xa5c6, ASCII 'KEISUKE' in baseline.sav.
fields.name: wrestler_01_last_name

fields.description: Slot 19 status flag: 0x81 = user-edited CAW slot ('KAMIKAZE' with custom single-char first name 'E'). Only 0x81 in the default roster range, marking a modified record.
fields.evidence: FUN_080377b8 slot loop, slot 19 base = 0xa56c + 19*0x48 = 0xaac4; flag byte 0x81 in baseline.sav vs 0x80 for untouched slots.
fields.name: wrestler_19_status

fields.description: Slot 21 status flag: 0x00 = empty/unused slot (still carries default ROM name data 'D.SILVER'). Proves the flag byte, not the name bytes, gates slot use.
fields.evidence: FUN_080377b8 slot loop, slot 21 base = 0xa56c + 21*0x48 = 0xab54; flag byte 0x00 in baseline.sav while name bytes remain populated.
fields.name: wrestler_21_status

fields.description: Stable/team entry 0 full name, NUL-padded ('VIEW JAPAN'). First of 16 entries written by the 16-iteration header loop.
fields.evidence: FUN_080377b8 first loop (16 iterations, save stride 0x2c) 0x18-byte copy to entry base; entry 0 at save 0xe000..0xe017 = 'VIEW JAPAN' in baseline.sav.
fields.name: stable_00_name

fields.description: Stable/team entry 0 abbreviation, NUL-padded ('VJP'), at entry base + 0x1a.
fields.evidence: FUN_080377b8 first loop 0x10-byte copy to entry base + ROM-stride offset; entry 0 abbrev at save 0xe01a..0xe029 = 'VJP' in baseline.sav.
fields.name: stable_00_abbrev

fields.description: Stable/team entry 1 full name, NUL-padded ('TEAM BLACK'). Confirms the 0x2c entry stride (entry 1 base = 0xe000 + 0x2c).
fields.evidence: FUN_080377b8 first loop save stride 0x2c; entry 1 at save 0xe02c..0xe043 = 'TEAM BLACK' in baseline.sav.
fields.name: stable_01_name
